title: Conditions/List (1-500)
html:
The list of all conditions in the game is split into the following pages so as to limit the size of each page:

  • Conditions/List (1-500)
  • Conditions/List (501-1000)
  • Conditions/List (1001-1500)
Condition Effects
A Clown in Town
  • Rue the day you crossed a fey. You were cruel to Dolly Thrice; now you'll have to pay the price.
  • This condition can only be obtained by smashing the Moonlantern held by Kar'niss.
  • Applies clown makeup to the victim.
A Mist Most Scarlet
  • Orin has gained 25 temporary hit points, a +2 bonus to Strength, and advantage on Wisdom  Saving Throws.
A Most Bloody Inheritance
  • The Dread Lord Bhaal looks favourably on his chosen. You can cast  Stunning Gaze and your Critical Hit Attack Roll requirement is reduced by 2. This effect can stack.
Aberrant Shape
  • Your Intellect Devourer form has 21 Hit Points.
  • You gain the  Claws,  Devour Intellect, and  Synaptic Discharge abilities.
Ability Drain: Charisma
  • Charisma reduced by  Ability Drain.
Ability Drain: Dexterity
  • Dexterity reduced by  Ability Drain
Ability Drain: Intelligence
  • Intelligence reduced by  Ability Drain.
Ability Drain: Strength
  • Strength reduced by  Ability Drain.
Ability Drain: Wisdom
  • Wisdom reduced by  Ability Drain.
Abjure Enemy: Frightened
  • The affected creature cannot move. Frightened creatures also have  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Attack Rolls.
Abjure Enemy: Slow
  • The affected creature's Movement speed is halved. Taking damage ends this condition.
Absolute Consumption
  • All of the creature's abilities are reduced by 5. When this effect ends, it drops  Prone
  • Regain 2d10⁠⁠Hit Points
Absolute Consumption
  • All of the creature's abilities are reduced by 9. When this effect ends, it drops  Prone
  • Regain 10d10⁠⁠Hit Points
Absolute Consumption
  • All of the creature's abilities are reduced by 8. When this effect ends, it drops  Prone
  • Regain 8d10⁠⁠Hit Points
Absolute Consumption
  • All of the creature's abilities are reduced by 7. When this effect ends, it drops  Prone
  • Regain 6d10⁠⁠Hit Points
Absolute Consumption
  • All of the creature's abilities are reduced by 6. When this effect ends, it drops  Prone
  • Regain 4d10⁠⁠Hit Points
Absolute's Enemy
  • Enemies have  Advantage on attacks against you.
Absorb Elements: Acid Damage
  • The affected entity deals an additional 1d6⁠⁠Acid damage the next time it deals damage with a weapon.
Absorb Elements: Cold Damage
  • The affected entity deals an additional 1d6⁠⁠Cold damage the next time it deals damage with a weapon.
Absorb Elements: Fire Damage
  • The affected entity deals an additional 1d6⁠⁠Fire damage the next time it deals damage with a weapon.
Absorb Elements: Lightning Damage
  • The affected entity deals an additional 1d6⁠⁠Lightning damage the next time it deals damage with a weapon.
Absorb Elements: Thunder Damage
  • The affected entity deals an additional 1d6⁠⁠Thunder damage the next time it deals damage with a weapon.
Absorbed Essence: Abazigal
  •  Sarevok's attacks deal maximum damage.
Absorbed Essence: Amelyssan
  • Sarevok's attacks now heal him by 2d12⁠⁠Hit Points each time.
Absorbed Essence: Illasera
  •  Sarevok is permanently  Hastened and can't be  Paralysed,  Restrained, or have his movement speed reduced in any way.
Absorbed Essence: Sendai
  • Sarevok's  Armour Class is increased by 6.
Absorbed Intellect
  • Intelligence is being reduced by 1.
  • Regain 1d8⁠⁠Hit Points
Absorbed Intellect
  • Intelligence is being reduced by 5.
  • Regain 5d8⁠⁠Hit Points
Absorbed Intellect
  • Intelligence is being reduced by 4.
  • Regain 4d8⁠⁠Hit Points
Absorbed Intellect
  • Intelligence is being reduced by 3.
  • Regain 3d8⁠⁠Hit Points
Absorbed Intellect
  • Intelligence is being reduced by 2.
  • Regain 2d8⁠⁠Hit Points
Acid
  • Reduces  Armour Class by 2.
Acid Infusion
  • The affected entity deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Acid the next time it deals damage with a weapon.
Acid Reflux
  • Acid damage has spoiled Thisobald's special brew, letting him use  Acidic Regurgitation.
Acid Resistance
  • Resistant to ⁠Acid damage.
Acid Resistance Aura
  • The fantastical powers of this hallucinatory imp give all nearby creatures Resistance to ⁠Acid damage.
Action Surge
  • Can take an extra Action this turn.
Adamantine Reverberation
  • While it has temporary hit points, this creature's movement speed is doubled. Immediately after losing these temporary hit points, the creature knocks back foes 4 m (13 ft) with a shockwave that deals 4d8⁠⁠Thunder.
Adrip with Kereska's Acid
  • Affected entity has resistance to ⁠Acid damage.
  • Its acid spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus.
  • When it deals spell damage, it possibly inflict 3 turns of  Noxious Fumes upon the target.
  • While attuned to Kereska's acid it can cast  Melf's Acid Arrow and  Hunger of Hadar at 5th level once per short rest.
Adroit Caster
  • Cantrips targeting foes and allies can target an additional creature. The same target can be chosen twice.
Aegis of the Absolute
  • The Netherbrain is Immune to all types of damage it took in the previous round until the start of its next turn.
Against All Odds
  • The unlikely actions of the party in the Morphic Pool were a surprise to even the Netherbrain.
  • The successful roll has left the Netherbrain wounded, reducing its starting HP for the encounter.
Agitated
  • The rothé is nervous and afraid - ready to attack at the slightest scare. Has  Advantage on  Attack Rolls.
Aid
  • Hit point maximum increased by 5⁠⁠Hit Points.
  • Hit point maximum increases by a further 5⁠⁠Hit Points for every Spell Slot Level above 2 used.
Alarmed Debtor
  • This creature has spotted you as an intruder.
Alcohol
  • Has  Disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks.
Alternate Form: Dire Wolf
  • Transformed into a Dire Wolf in all the ways that matter.
Alternate Form: Minotaur
  • Transformed into a Minotaur in all the ways that matter.
Alternate Form: Phase Spider
  • Transformed into a Phase Spider in all the ways that matter.
Alternate Form: Shadow Mastiff
  • Transformed into a Shadow Mastiff in all the ways that matter.
Ambushed
  • Attack Rolls against the affected entity have  Advantage and it has  Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity Checks.
  • Taking damage or being Helped ends this condition.
Ambushing
  • Affected entity will attack as soon as its enemies are within reach. It can only be spotted with a successful Perception Check.
Ambushing Bite
  • The creature's next bite may  Ambush its target.
Ancient Grudges
  • Filled with a touch of arcane gith knowledge.
  • Has  Advantage on Attack Rolls against aberrations.
Animalistic Vitality
  • Affected entity regains 2d8⁠⁠Hit Points of health every round when below 60 HP. It also receives an additional 3.5 m (12 ft) of movement speed. [See: Bugs]
Anointed in Splendour
  • Has a +2 bonus to all  Saving Throws.
Ansur's Ire
  • A storm of vicious lightning is soon to erupt - striking all standing in the open.
Aquatic Siphon
  • A nearby water myrmidon grants the affected entity Immunity to Cold damage and an additional 3d8⁠⁠Cold damage to  Elemental Retort.
  • The affected entity also gains temporary access to  Cone of Cold and an additional  Reaction per turn.
Arcane Acuity
  • Affected entity has a +1 bonus to its spell  Attack Rolls and spell save DC for each remaining turn.
  • Reduce the duration by 2 each time the entity takes damage.
  • Arcane Acuity has a maximum Duration: 10 turns.
Arcane Ammunition
  • Ranged weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠⁠Force.
Arcane Battery
  • Affected entity's next spell doesn't cost a spell slot in order to cast.
Arcane Charge
  • While damaging  Threatened entities, deal +2 bonus damage with spells.[See: Bugs]
Arcane Critical
  • The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 2. This effect can stack.
Arcane Hunger
  • Gale's spirit is being drained. He has  Disadvantage to Constitution  Saving Throws.
Arcane Inheritor
  • Rolan has taken command of Ramazith's Tower, increasing his level to 11 and granting him a host of new magic powers.
Arcane Lock
  • Locked through magical means. Can't be opened by lockpicking or the use of  Knock.
Arcane Synergy
  • Weapon attacks deal additional damage equal to affected entity's Spell Casting Ability Modifier.
Arcane Ward
  • Your Arcane Ward blocks damage equal to its charges and then loses 1 charge. Casting Abjuration spells will add charges equal to the level of the spell.
Arcanely Honed
  • Deal additional damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Ardent Apostle
  • Offering their cries of pain without protection. Has a +4 bonus to Performance and Intimidation checks.
Armour of Agathys

Gained  5 × spell level temporary hit points. If hit with a melee attack, the attacker takes 5 × spell level⁠⁠Cold damage. This effect ends when the temporary hit points are lost.

Armour of the Swarm
  • Your swarm grants you a +2 bonus to your  Armour Class until the start of your next turn.
Arms of Hadar
  • Can't take  Reactions.
Arrow of Ilmater
  • Cannot regain Hit Points
Arsonist's Oil
  • Affected entity has been stripped of its Fire Resistance.
Ascended Fiend
  • Raphael has gorged on souls and enhanced his fiendish powers, granting him an even deadlier array of spells and abilities. In this form,  Soul Overcharge will not prevent him from using Souls to cast spells.
Aspect of the Elk
  • Movement Speed increased by +1.5 m (5 ft), as long as the affected entity stays near the barbarian.
Aspect of the Elk Aura
  • Affected entity and nearby allies have a +1.5 m (5 ft) bonus to Movement Speed.
Aspect of the Stallion
  • Gained Barbarian Level * 2  temporary hit points.
Aspect of the Wolf
  • Affected entity has a +Dexterity Modifier bonus to Stealth Checks, as long as it stays near the barbarian.
Aspect of the Wolf Aura
  • Affected entity and nearby allies have a +Dexterity Modifier bonus to Stealth Checks.
Assassin's Blood
  • Creature must succeed a Constitution  Saving Throw or take 1d12⁠⁠Poison and get Poisoned until the next Long Rest.
  • On a successful save, it still takes half damage.
Astral Clarity
  • Your Intelligence gets a +2 bonus. You have  Advantage on Intelligence  Saving Throws.
Astral Conduit
  • The affected entity can't move, take actions, bonus actions, or reactions while holding open the Astral Rift, but can Summon an ally every other turn.
Astral Gravity
  • Gravity on the Astral Plane is different than on Faerûn.
  • The affected entity is Immune to Falling damage and its Jump distance is tripled.
  • Carrying capacity is tripled.
Astral Knowledge
  • Has Proficiency in all Skills of a chosen Ability.
Astral Knowledge: Charisma
  • Has Proficiency in Deception, Intimidation, Performance, and Persuasion.
Astral Knowledge: Dexterity
  • Has Proficiency in Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, and Stealth.
Astral Knowledge: Intelligence
  • Has Proficiency in Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, and Religion.
Astral Knowledge: Strength
  • Has Proficiency in Athletics.
Astral Knowledge: Wisdom
  • Has Proficiency in Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, and Survival.
Astral Lethargy
  •  Stunned for a turn after after being hit by blast of energy.
Astrally Projected
  • While your body resides in the cold expanses of the Astral Sea, you have projected a likeness of yourself here for the evening.
At Death's Door
  • The more the creature rests, the worse it feels.
At Death's Door
  • Advanced Toxic Infection. Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Charisma, and Wisdom are reduced by 6. The more the creature rests, the worse it feels.
At Death's Door
  • Moderate Toxic Infection. Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Charisma, and Wisdom are reduced by 4. The more the creature rests, the worse it feels.
At Death's Door
  • Emergent Toxic Infection. Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Charisma, and Wisdom are reduced by 2. The more the creature rests, the worse it feels.
Atrophied
  • One of the affected entity's Abilities has been reduced to 0, causing it to die instantly.
Auntie Ethel's Special Brew
  • The affected creature takes 2d6⁠⁠Poison at the start of every turn until passing a  DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw.
Aura of Bloodthirst
  • Any nearby creatures with the Rampage trait can make a bite attack as a bonus action.
Aura of Brutality
  • All servants of  Bane around this character gain an additional +1 Strength. This effect can stack.
Aura of Conquest
  •  Frightened enemies within 3 m (10 ft) take 5⁠⁠Psychic damage per turn.
Aura of Courage
  • The paladin and any nearby allies can't be  Frightened.
Aura of Courage
  • Can't be  Frightened within 3 m (10 ft) of the spellcaster.
Aura of Devotion
  • The paladin and any nearby allies can't be  Charmed.
Aura of Devotion
  • Can't be  Charmed within 3 m (10 ft) of the spellcaster.
Aura of Hate
  • This creature and all fiends and undead within 3 m (10 ft) gain this creature's charisma modifier as a bonus to their melee weapon damage.
Aura of Hate
  • Gains a bonus to melee weapon damage equal to the charisma modifier of the creature emanating the aura.
Aura of Murder
  • Nearby hostile creatures become Vulnerable to Piercing damage, unless they are Resistant or Immune to it.
Aura of Murder
  • Affected entity is Vulnerable to ⁠Piercing damage.
Aura of Murder
  • Enemies within 3 m (10 ft) are Vulnerable to Piercing damage, unless they are Immune to it.
Aura of Murder
  • Affected entity is Vulnerable to ⁠Piercing damage.
Aura of Possibility
  • While near the God of Ambition, this creature has a +10 bonus to all Ability Checks.
Aura of Possibility
  • Any allies near Gale Dekarios, the God of Ambition, receive a +10 bonus to all Ability Checks.
Aura of Protection
  • The creature and its allies within 3 m (10 ft) gain the creature's charisma modifier as a bonus to their saving throws.
Aura of Protection
  • Gains a bonus to saving throws equal to the charisma modifier of the creature emanating the aura.
Aura of Terror
  • Nearby enemies have  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and  Saving Throws.
  • Creatures that can't be  Frightened are immune to this aura.
Aura of Terror
  • Bane's oppressive aura gives the affected entity  Disadvantage on attack rolls and  Saving Throws while within 3 m (10 ft) of the spellcaster.
Aura of Vile Oblivion
  • All nearby light sources get extinguished when the Wraith is nearby.
Aura of Warding
  • The paladin and any nearby allies have Resistance to damage from spells.
Aura of Warding
  • Resistant to damage from spells within 3 m (10 ft) of the spellcaster.
Avatar of BOOOAL
  • The sight of a kuo-toa servant dying fills BOOOAL with bloodlust. It regains 3d6⁠⁠Hit Points when it kills a creature and can attack three times.
Avatar of Tyranny
  • Bane has come to Gortash's aid! Gortash has  150 temporary hit points,  Advantage on  Strength Checks and  Strength Saving Throws... And now has fearsome new powers!
  • Affected entity gains an extra 1d4⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage to unarmed attacks and Immunity to ⁠Thunder, ⁠Fire, and ⁠Force damage.
Aversion of Fire
  • Recently suffered ⁠Fire damage. Has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
Baleful Knowledge
  • Dark whispers pervade the creature's mind.  Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks.
Bane
  • Has a -1d4 penalty to  Attack Rolls and  Saving Throws.
Bane's Brutality
  • Affected entity gains +1 to its Strength ability. This effect can stack.
Bane's Command
  • This creature can channel  Bane's Wrath - it is the Black Hand's will.
Baneful Strike
  • Affected entity has a -1d4 penalty to  Saving Throws against its attacker's next spell.
Banished
  • Banished from this plane of existence.
  • Can't be targeted.
  • Can't move or take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions
Bardic Inspiration
  • Can use  Bardic Inspiration to add a +1d6 bonus to the next  Attack Roll,  Ability Check, or  Saving Throw.
  • Bonus depends on originating Bard's level
Barkskin
  •  Armour Class increased to 16.
Basking in Loviatar's Love
  • You revel in the clarity granted by your pain. You have a +2 bonus to  Attack Rolls and Wisdom  Saving Throws for 3 turns.
Beacon of Hope
  • Has Advantage on Wisdom and Death  Saving Throws.
  • Regains the maximum possible Hit Points when healed.
Bear's Endurance
  • Has  Advantage on Constitution Checks.
  • Gain 7 Temporary Hit Points.
Beckoning Darkness
  • Haunted by darkness.
  • Affected entity takes 2d8⁠⁠Necrotic damage if it enters or starts its turn in a Lightly or Heavily Obscured area.
Befuddled
  • Affected entity can't control its actions and wanders around without direction.
Befuddled
  • Affected entity can't control its actions and wanders around without direction.
Beguiled
  • This creature has been charmed by Raphael and cannot target him with attacks or spells.
Bend Luck: Ability Check Bonus
  • Wild magic has twisted the affected entity's fate. It gained a +1d4 bonus to Ability Checks.
Bend Luck: Ability Check Penalty
  • Wild magic has twisted the affected entity's fate. It gained a -1d4 penalty to Ability Checks.
Benign Transposition: Spent
  • Affected entity has used its  Benign Transposition feature for the day. To replenish this feature, the entity must cast a Conjuration spell of Level 1 or higher.
Berserk
  • A frenetic rage racks the affected entity's flesh. Its Multiattacks each deal an additional 1d8⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage and knocks targets  Prone
  • It also gains Resistance to Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning damage, and has  Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws.
  • This frenzy ends if the affected entity regains all its hit points.
Bhaal's Boon
  • Bhaal revels in the affected entity's gift for murder, granting it a +1 bonus to  Armour Class per marked kill.
  • 1 point of this bonus Armour Class is lost each time the Slayer avoids an attack.[See: Bugs]
Bhaal's Edict
  • If you don't kill another creature before the end of your next turn, you will die instantly.
Bhaal's Murderous Mark
  • Affected entity's death grants a +1  Armour Class bonus to the Slayer.
Bhaalist Ritual Target
  • As part of the challenge to enter the temple, the affected entity has become the target of a chanting cultist, the Farslayer, who can cast  Bhaal's Power Word Kill once its profane ritual ends. Exiting the Farslayer's chanting range of 55 m (183 ft) makes you invulnerable to the effect. Slaying the Farslayer stops the ritual and wins the conflict.
Bhaalspawn Essence: Abazigal
  • When Abazigal's ghost dies, Sarevok will absorb his essence and deal maximum damage on all his attacks.
Bhaalspawn Essence: Amelyssan
  • When Amelyssan's ghost dies, Sarevoks attacks will heal him for 2d12⁠⁠Hit Points
Bhaalspawn Essence: Illasera
  • When Illasera's ghost dies, Sarevok will be permanently  Hastened and will be unaffected by Paralysis, Restraints, or any attempts to reduce his movement speed.
Bhaalspawn Essence: Sendai
  • When Sendai's ghost dies, Sarevok will have his  Armour Class increased by 6.
Big Pig
  • Pigs are smart and pigs are fun - that's why Dolly made you one!
Black Hole
  • The black hole pulls nearby creatures and deals 3d10+4⁠⁠Force damage. The nearby area is Difficult Terrain and can  Slow creatures within it.[See: Bugs]
Black Tentacles
  • Restrained by dark tendrils. Affected entity can't move and takes 3d6⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage per turn.
  • Attack Rolls against the affected entity have  Advantage, while the entity's Attack Rolls and Dexterity Saving Throws have  Disadvantage
Blacked Out
  • Thisobald has overindulged in his own brew. He has a -5 penalty to Armour Class and is Vulnerable to Slashing, Piercing, Bludgeoning and Thunder Damage.
Blade Barrier
  • Creatures that approach the barrier are slit and sliced and cut and carved like so much meat on a blood-grouted block.
  • Affected entities take 6d10⁠⁠Slashing damage per turn.
Blade Ward
  • Has Resistance against ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Slashing damage.
Bladesinging
  • Invoking the Bladesong. You gain a +2/+3/+4 bonus to  Armour Class and your movement speed is increased by 3 m (10 ft). You also gain  Advantage in Acrobatics and a +2/+3/+4 bonus to Constitution  Saving Throws.
  • The AC and saving throws bonus is +2, +3, or +4 at Bladesinger levels 2, 5, or 9 respectively.
Bladesong Damage Charge
  • A charge that will increase how much damage you deal to enemies by 1d6⁠⁠Force when using  Bladesong Climax.
  • You can accumulate these charges by casting Level 1 spells or above that are not weapon attacks.
Bladesong Healing Charge
  • A charge that increases how much you heal yourself and your allies by 1d6⁠⁠Hit Points when using  Bladesong Climax.
  • You can accumulate these charges by attacking with weapons.
Bladesong Impeded
  • Bladesinging impeded by armour/shield/weapon. Until the armour/shield/weapon is removed, your  Bladesong won't grant any benefits or let you generate Bladesong Charges.
Blazing Retaliation
  • Affected entity has a +1 bonus to  Armour Class
  • When a melee attack misses it, deal 1d6⁠⁠Fire damage to the attacker.
Bleeding
  • Takes 2⁠⁠SlashingDRS damage at the start of each turn and has  Disadvantage on Constitution  Saving Throws.
  • Removed by healing.
Bless
  • Gains a +1d4 bonus to  Attack Rolls and  Saving Throws.
Blessing of Authority
  • Affected entity's next non-lethal attack gains a +1d4 bonus to  Attack Rolls.
Blessing of Selûne
  • Selûne's radiance protects you against the lesser effects of the  Shadow Curse. But beware - even Her light cannot guard against the darkest shadows.
  • Permits safe passage through some of the Shadow-Cursed Lands without a light source.
  • Resistant to magical ⁠Necrotic damage.
Blessing of the Trickster

Has  Advantage on Stealth Checks.

Blinded
  • The affected creature has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls.
  • Ranged attacks and spells of the affected creature have a range of 3 m (10 ft).
  • Attack Rolls against affected creatures have  Advantage.
  • At the end of each turn, the affected creature makes a  Constitution Saving Throw. If successful, the condition is removed.
Blinded
  • Has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls. Range of attacks and spells reduced to 3 m (10 ft).
  • Attack Rolls against Blinded creatures have  Advantage.
Blindness
  • Has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls. Range of attacks and spells reduced to 3 m (10 ft).
  • Attack Rolls against Blinded creatures have  Advantage.
  • At the end of each turn, the affected creature rolls a  Constitution Saving Throw against the Spell Save DC of the casater. If successful, the condition is removed.
Blink
  • At the end of each turn, there is a chance the affected entity gets  Blinked to the Ethereal Plane, where it can't be harmed, seen or affected.
  • While in the  Ethereal Plane, the entity can't move or interact with anything in the world. It can only choose to teleport up to 6 m (20 ft). When combat ends, so does this effect.
Blinked to the Ethereal Plane
  • Affected entity is in the  Ethereal Plane, where it can't be harmed, seen, or affected.
  • While in the Ethereal Plane, the entity can't move or interact with anything in the world. It can choose to teleport up to 6 m (20 ft).
  • At the end of each turn, there is a chance it reappears in the Material Plane. When combat ends, so does this effect.
  • Immune to  Bleeding.
Bliss Spores
  • Affected entity has a +1d6 bonus to Attack Rolls, Ability Checks, and Saving throws until the next Long Rest.
Bloated
  • Restrained due to sickness and bloat.
Blocked by Bhaalist Mischief
  • This door cannot be opened until the Farslayer is defeated.
Blocked Warrens
  • Kobolds cannot emerge from this tunnel while it is obstructed.
Blood-draw Sickness
  • Nothing is ever free - until the next long rest the affected entity has a -1 to all dice rolls.
Blood-Sapped
  • Hit point maximum reduced by 8 per turn remaining. Creature will die if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.
Blood-scent Frenzy
  • Affected entity has  Advantage on melee attacks against any target that doesn't have all of its hit points, provided it's not a construct, an ooze, a plant, or an elemental.
Bloodless
  • Feels a bit woozy. -1 to all Attack Rolls, Saving Throws, and most Ability Checks.
Bloodlust
  • Creature can attack three times. It regains 3d8⁠⁠Hit Points if it lands a killing blow.
Bloodrender
  • Affected entity deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠piercing on all hits while taking 1d4⁠⁠piercing per turn.
Bloodthirst
  • Gains  Bite as a bonus action.
Bloody Favour
  • Bhaal's Chosen will be granted a profane boon at the start of every turn.
Blooming Dead
  • This Undead heals 4d6⁠⁠Hit Points at the start of every turn while it is within  The Dead Wastes.
Bludgeon the Weak
  • Affected entity is Vulnerable to ⁠Bludgeoning damage for 3 turns, or until it takes damage.
Blurred
  • Attackers have  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls against this creature, unless they do not rely on sight or can see through illusions.
Bolstering Brew
  • Affected entity's Strength score is increased by 6 while it is infused with Thisobald's current brew.
Bolstering Magic: Boon
  • Bolstered by wild magic. Has a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Ability Checks
Bone Chilled
  • Can not regain  hit points.
  • Cannot help  Downed characters.
  • If Undead, has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls.
Booming Blade
  • Affected entity will take 1d8⁠⁠Thunder damage when it moves.
Boon of Servitude
  • Armour Class increased by 2. Regains 2d4+Spellcasting Modifier⁠⁠Hit Points each turn.
BOOOAL's Benediction
  •  Advantage on  Attack Rolls against  Bleeding creatures, as long as there are Kuo-toa to worship BOOOAL.
BOOOAL's Blessing
  • The wielder has  Advantage on  Attack Rolls against Bleeding creatures, as long as there are Kuo-toa to worship BOOOAL.
BOOOAL's Faithful
  • Chance to apply  Bleeding to targets.
Bottled Breath
  • Affected Entity is able to cast  Gust of Wind once per long rest.
Bound
  • This relic is bound to its current owner by a powerful aura.
  • Bound items cannot be removed from your inventory.
Bound Weapon
  • Ritually bound to its wielder.
